jobs.title: Associate, Venture Investor
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com .

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

- Seek Excellence.

- Be Selective To Be Effective.

- Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.

- Disagree Transparently.

- Encourage Independent Decision-Making.

- Build Dream Teams.

Who You Are:

The Ventures team is seeking highly motivated venture investors to join the team. This role spans the full investment lifecycle, including developing investment theses, sourcing, and evaluating opportunities, and supporting portfolio companies.
Investors at Galaxy Ventures operate with a high degree of autonomy and are expected to contribute meaningfully to investment decisions, including presenting thesis-driven opportunities to Galaxy’s investment committee.
You will be exposed to all aspects of the venture investment process, working alongside a small, high-conviction team investing across the convergence of financial services and digital assets, from early-stage startups through growth and pre-IPO.
You will interact regularly with portfolio company management teams and co-investors and play a meaningful role in evaluating new opportunities and monitoring portfolio performance.
The role requires strong self-motivation, analytical rigor, sound judgment, and a collaborative mindset.

What You’ll Do:

- Build and maintain relationships with entrepreneurs, investors, and ecosystem participants to develop a strong sourcing network

- Develop investment theses through deep research into emerging market trends

- Source and evaluate potential investment opportunities

- Conduct in-depth due diligence and contribute to the team’s overall investment judgment

- Perform financial analysis including building financial models, valuations, comparable analysis, cap table and waterfall modeling

- Prepare and present investment memos and pitch decks for new and follow-on investments

- Support portfolio companies on corporate strategy, business development, and other high-priority initiatives

- Monitor portfolio company performance and track key metrics

- Pitching in on various firm related projects

What We’re Looking For:

- Associate: 2+ years of relevant experience

- Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, or a related field

- Prior venture capital/growth equity investing experience preferred, and/or 2-3+ years at top-tier consulting firm, investment bank, or tech company

- Strong interest and domain knowledge in crypto, fintech, and software ecosystems

- Strong quantitative skills including financial modeling (DCF, LBOs, cap tables, liquidation waterfalls) and proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and emerging AI tools

- A self-starter who can work independently and drive projects forward

- Tireless work ethic – someone who will hustle to support the team to source, diligence, and execute on great investment opportunities

- Unwavering dedication to helping founders

What We Offer:

- Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus

- Hybrid/Flexible Working Arrangements

- Flexible Time Off (paid)

- 3% 401(k) company contribution

- Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees, partners, and other dependents

- Generous paid Parental Leave

- Competitive family planning benefits for US employees

- Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry

- Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues

- Free daily snacks and weekly breakfasts/lunches

- Employee Resource Groups

- Free coaching and counseling sessions through Headspace

*Benefits may vary depending on location.

Apply now and join us as we grow the economy that runs on code.
The base salary ranges included below will be commensurate with candidate experience, expertise and local market. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise. At Galaxy, we maintain a total compensation philosophy which consists of a competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity incentives.

Base Salary Range
$150,000 — $175,000 USD

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com .

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

- Seek Excellence.

- Be Selective To Be Effective.

- Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.

- Disagree Transparently.

- Encourage Independent Decision-Making.

Who You Are

The Data Center Business Operations Manager is responsible for building, implementing, and continuously improving the operating frameworks, processes, and services that enable the business to operate consistently and effectively across locations and functions.

This role owns the development of enterprise-level business operations standards, including processes, procedures, governance, taxonomy, naming conventions, documentation standards, tools, and operating expectations that Project Managers and business teams use across the organization.

The Business Operations Manager partners closely with Finance, Procurement, Legal, HR, IT, and other corporate functions to translate company requirements into practical processes that meet the needs of the business and can be effectively implemented at the site and functional level.

The Business Operations Manager also leads the development and management of Workplace Services programs that require consistency and coordination across the organization, including vehicle fleet, uniforms, transportation services, culinary programs, and other shared operational services.

The Business Operations Manager establishes the program strategy, standards, processes, and expectations, while onsite Project Managers and local teams are responsible for implementing and managing those programs at the site level.

This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution: designing scalable enterprise processes, partnering with corporate functions, building operational programs, and ensuring those programs can be successfully implemented in the field.

What You’ll Do

Business Operations & Enterprise Standards

- Design, implement, and continuously improve enterprise-level business operations processes, procedures, workflows, governance standards, templates, tools, and operating expectations.

- Establish and maintain consistent standards for how information is organized and managed, including taxonomy, naming conventions, documentation standards, project structures, reporting conventions, and other common ways of working.

- Develop scalable frameworks and playbooks that Project Managers and business teams can use to execute work consistently across departments, projects, and locations.

- Identify recurring friction, process gaps, unclear ownership, inefficient handoffs, and inconsistencies across the business and implement scalable solutions.

- Create documentation, training, and implementation guidance that enables Project Managers and business teams to understand and consistently apply established processes and standards.

- Monitor adoption and effectiveness of business operations processes and standards, identifying gaps and driving continuous improvement as business needs evolve.

Cross-Functional Process & Project Support

- Partner closely with Finance, Procurement, Legal, HR, IT, and other corporate functions to translate company-wide requirements into practical processes that appropriately support the needs of the business.

- Partner with Finance and Procurement on the development and rollout of processes related to budgeting, forecasting, purchasing, vendor management, financial controls, and other requirements.

- Support Legal with project management and cross-functional coordination for initiatives requiring structured planning, ownership, milestones, dependencies, and follow-through.

- Establish clear engagement models, workflows, roles, responsibilities, and escalation paths so Project Managers and business teams understand when and how to engage Finance, Procurement, Legal, and other support functions.

Workplace Services Programs

- Build and oversee enterprise Workplace Services programs that support consistent, efficient operations across locations.

- Establish the strategy, standards, processes, service expectations, and governance for programs such as vehicle fleet, uniforms, transportation services, culinary services, onsite office space and other shared workplace or operational services.

- Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to establish appropriate vendor strategies, contracts, budgets, controls, and service-level expectations for Workplace Services programs.

- Develop enterprise playbooks and implementation standards for Workplace Services programs, providing clear direction to onsite Project Managers and local teams responsible for execution.

- Monitor program performance, service quality, cost, compliance, and business needs across locations and continuously improve programs as the organization evolves.

- Identify opportunities to standardize services, improve the employee experience, reduce operational friction, create efficiencies, and appropriately leverage enterprise scale.

Project Management Standards & Governance

- Establish enterprise project management standards, methodologies, tools, templates, and expectations that Project Managers can apply across the organization.

- Define how projects and initiatives are structured and tracked, including priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, ownership, status reporting, and escalation paths.

- Develop and maintain standards for project and work management systems, ensuring information is structured consistently and provides meaningful visibility across projects, departments, and locations.

- Establish appropriate reporting standards, dashboards, KPIs, portfolio reporting, and operating reviews to provide visibility into business priorities, execution, risks, dependencies, and organizational capacity.

- Establish effective meeting, communication, and operating rhythms, including portfolio reviews, leadership updates, cross-functional operating reviews, and escalation mechanisms.

- Provide guidance, tools, and operating direction to Project Managers across the organization while enabling individual PMs to remain accountable for execution within their respective functions or sites.

- Establish priorities, expectations, and operating standards for regional Project Managers and ensure their work aligns with broader business priorities and enterprise operating practices.

- Provide coaching, guidance, and development to regional Project Managers while creating accountability for execution and results.

- Ensure regional Project Managers effectively support sites within their respective regions by coordinating cross-functional initiatives, resolving operational issues, implementing enterprise programs, and maintaining visibility into local priorities, risks, and dependencies.

- Partner with site and functional leaders to ensure regional Project Manager resources are deployed against the highest-priority business needs.

What We’re Looking For

- 6+ years of experience in business operations, strategy and operations, program management, PMO operations, workplace operations, or a similar cross-functional role.

- Demonstrated experience designing and implementing scalable operating processes across multiple teams, functions, or locations rather than simply administering existing processes.

- Experience developing enterprise standards, operating procedures, governance frameworks, playbooks, taxonomies, documentation standards, and common ways of working.

- Strong understanding of how business operations interact with Finance, Procurement, Legal, HR, IT, and other corporate support functions.

- Experience translating corporate policies, controls, and functional requirements into practical operating processes that meet the needs of the business.

- Experience building or managing shared operational or Workplace Services programs, such as fleet, transportation, food and beverage/culinary, uniforms, facilities-related services, or other enterprise services.

- Strong program and project management capabilities, with experience establishing governance, accountability, reporting, and operating rhythms across complex organizations.

- Experience with portfolio reporting, KPI development, dashboards, process documentation, and project/work management platforms.

- Strong process-improvement mindset with the ability to identify root causes, simplify workflows, standardize where appropriate, and drive adoption of new ways of working.

- Ability to influence and create accountability across teams without direct reporting authority.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear, executable processes.

- Comfortable operating at both the strategic and detailed execution levels—able to design enterprise operating models and programs while remaining close enough to execution to ensure they work in practice.

- PMP or equivalent project/program management certification preferred.

jobs.title: VP, People Operations Manager - Global Payroll & HRIS
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com .

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

- Seek Excellence.

- Be Selective To Be Effective.

- Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.

- Disagree Transparently.

- Encourage Independent Decision-Making.

- Build Dream Teams.

Who You Are:

Galaxy is seeking a People Operations Manager, Global Payroll & HRIS to join our People team in a hands-on, execution-focused role supporting our global workforce. This position will initially join on a temporary-to-permanent basis and will play a critical role in two key areas: global payroll operations and the implementation of Workday, with a targeted go-live date of January 1, 2027. In your first three-six months, success will mean helping Galaxy deliver a clean and well-controlled Workday go-live, ensuring payroll readiness and data integrity, and establishing scalable processes that can transition into steady-state People Operations

Leading up to go-live, this individual will partner closely with People, Payroll, Finance, Technology, external implementation partners, and other key stakeholders to support the successful implementation of Workday. This will include data validation and migration, business process design, testing, integrations, payroll readiness, documentation, and change management.

At the same time, this person will help manage and strengthen Galaxy's global payroll operations, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time and that payroll processes, controls, data, and vendor relationships can scale with the organization.

Following implementation, the role will transition toward ongoing ownership and optimization of Workday and global payroll operations, including system administration, data integrity, reporting, process improvement, controls, and the employee experience.

We're looking for someone who enjoys being close to the details while understanding the broader operational picture - someone who can identify an issue in a payroll reconciliation or employee record, work cross-functionally to resolve it, and then improve the underlying process so it doesn't happen again.

What You’ll Do:

- Workday Implementation & HRIS

- Serve as a key People Operations partner for Galaxy's Workday implementation ahead of the January 1, 2027 go-live.

- Partner with internal stakeholders and external implementation resources to support requirements gathering, business process design, system configuration, integrations, and implementation activities.

- Coordinate and execute data preparation, cleansing, validation, and migration activities to ensure accurate employee and payroll data within Workday

- Develop and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), document results, identify issues, and partner with appropriate stakeholders through resolution.

- Support payroll parallel testing and other payroll-readiness activities ahead of go-live.

- Help establish scalable HRIS processes, controls, documentation, and governance.

- Develop process documentation, SOPs, training materials, and resources for People team members, managers, and employees.

- Support change management, training, and communications associated with the Workday launch.

- Following go-live, help manage ongoing Workday administration, including business processes, employee data, reporting, security/access, system updates, and issue resolution.

- Continuously identify opportunities to improve, automate, and scale People processes through Workday and other technologies.

- Global Payroll

- Support the end-to-end administration of payroll across Galaxy's global employee population, partnering with internal teams and third-party payroll providers as appropriate.

- Review payroll inputs and outputs to ensure employees are paid accurately, completely, and on time.

- Perform payroll audits, reconciliations, and variance analyses and proactively investigate and resolve discrepancies.

- Coordinate employee lifecycle changes impacting payroll, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, benefits deductions, leaves, and other employee changes.

- Partner with Finance on payroll funding, reconciliations, reporting, and related accounting requirements.

- Work with People team partners to ensure HRIS, payroll, benefits, and employee data remain aligned across systems and vendors.

- Support payroll compliance requirements across applicable jurisdictions and partner with internal and external subject-matter experts as needed.

- Manage day-to-day relationships with payroll vendors, escalating and resolving issues while holding partners accountable for service and accuracy.

- Maintain payroll calendars, controls, documentation, and standard operating procedures.

- Identify opportunities to standardize and strengthen global payroll processes as Galaxy continues to grow.

- People Operations

- Maintain a high standard of employee data accuracy and integrity across People systems.

- Produce and analyze People and payroll data to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for operational improvement.

- Support employee inquiries related to payroll, HR systems, and People processes, providing a high level of service and discretion.

- Partner cross-functionally across People, Finance, Legal, Technology, and other teams on projects affecting employee data and operations.

- Support audits, compliance requests, reporting, and other People Operations initiatives as needed.

- Handle highly sensitive and confidential employee information with sound judgment and discretion.

- Support global payroll operations across multiple jurisdictions (e.g., US, UK, Ireland, Portugal, and EOR-supported countries), including timesheet approvals, payroll data prep, and coordination with in-country payroll vendors.

- Assist with new hire onboarding, employee data changes, transfers, and offboarding processes within Workday and related HR systems.

- Prepare reports, reconciliations, and ad hoc analyses to support payroll and people operations initiatives.

- Help document processes and maintain SOPs for HRIS, payroll, and people operations workflows.

- Respond to employee and manager inquiries related to payroll, HR data, and system access with a high level of accuracy and discretion.

What We’re Looking For:

- 6+ years of relevant experience in People Operations, payroll, HRIS, HR technology, or a related field.

- Hands-on experience supporting payroll operations; global or multi-country payroll experience strongly preferred.

- Experience working with Workday or another enterprise HRIS; direct Workday implementation experience is strongly preferred.

- Experience participating in an HRIS implementation, migration, configuration, or significant system transformation is highly desirable.

- Strong understanding of the connection between HRIS data, payroll, benefits, Finance, and employee lifecycle processes.

- Demonstrated ability to reconcile complex datasets, identify discrepancies, and drive issues through resolution.

- Strong Excel skills and comfort working with large datasets, reporting, and analysis.

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive workstreams simultaneously.

- Strong project management skills and the ability to keep deliverables moving across multiple stakeholders.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where processes may still be evolving.

- Takes ownership, works effectively both independently and collaboratively, and knows when to escalate issues.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or operational issues for different audiences.

- Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive employee and compensation information.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Bonus Points:

- Experience with a Workday HCM and/or Payroll implementation, particularly involving a January 1 or year-start cutover.

- Experience supporting payroll across North America, EMEA, and/or APAC.

- Experience working with multiple local payroll providers or a global payroll platform.

- Familiarity with payroll integrations, data feeds, benefits integrations, and Finance/GL processes.

- Experience developing UAT scripts, executing parallel payroll testing, or supporting system cutovers.

- Experience building or improving payroll controls, SOPs, and audit processes.

- Experience in a high-growth, global financial services or technology organization.
